page.layout: Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. Two circular medallion portraits side by side, each with its legend around the rim. Below them one column of running text with two paragraphs. No margin notes. Gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: PAULUS de Castro, Jureconsultus celeberrimus, multa conscripsit ad leges pertinentia, stylo non minus elegati quàm utili, quibus, vir admirabilis suæ eruditionis & prudentiæ testi-monia omnibus clara exhibuit. Jus docuit, in omnibus ferè claris Italiæ Academiis. Scripsit super Codice lib.9.super ff. veteri lib.24. Consilia elegantissima, singularia, & opus Consiliorum in duo volumina partitum, cum pluribus aliis cōmētatio-nibus composuit: ut posteritati, singulari beneficio, & propensa in studiosos omnes, voluntate, sese profuturum aliquando gloriaretur, quemadmodum ipsis profuit qui eodem seculo vixe-runt. Scripsit etiam super ff. novo libros duodecim: super ff. inforciati, libros quatuordecim: super Institutis lib.quatuor. Citatur quoque repetitio eius in i.ff.ver. de indiciis, l. si de vi. Consilia eius ab erroribus vindicata & additionibus, novisque rerū notabilium summis, supra priores editiones feliciter aucta, studio & opera Leonardi à lege, Venetiis impressa sunt 1570. in folio, & anno 1571. Claruit anno reparatæ salutis humanæ 1437.

ZABARELLA natione Patauinus, Roma. ecclesiæ Cardinalis presbyter juris pontificij consultissimus, unde amplissimam dignitatem suam exornavit, ut prelatos decet, erat maximo ingenio & doctrina præditus, cuius specimen frugiferum edidisse eum, ipsius scripta satis testantur. Floruit circiter annum Domini 1443.

page.notes: The medallion legends are printed in capitals around the rims: left "P · CASTRENSIS · P.", right "FRANC · ZABARELLA" (the first word runs along the lower left). The page number is only partly legible on the scan. The signature "Vvv 4" is printed at the foot. Long s has been written as plain s throughout; u/v and i/j are normalised as instructed.
